home.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 landscape game home screen concept image for an existing Nordic 3D cooperative real-time strategy game, NOORDHEIM.
Primary request: Show a finished game-native main menu interface with atmospheric sculpted low-poly 3D Nordic military art and clean modern matte pine interface styling.
Scene/backdrop: Left 55% of the screen is a close-up 3D command post diorama in a snowy Nordic forest: substantial red timber military buildings with dark slate roofs, sculpted low-poly spruce, chunky granite, ivory patchy snow, a small modern tracked military harvester, a few warm amber lamps. Winter sunshine casts long soft shadows. Geometry is deliberate and attractive, with visible facets and realistic proportions, modern military equipment, no fantasy.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:9 screen, full-bleed background scene. The beautiful left-side diorama has a calm dark pine fade at its upper left, behind a large ivory NOORDHEIM title with NORTHERN COMMAND beneath, plus a small tasteful geometric mountain insignia. Right 40% contains a compact enrolment panel with generous breathing room and a very restrained hierarchy. Do not crop the interface.
UI details: A small panel heading NORTHERN COMMAND, a Callsign input containing RAVEN-07, then four faction tiles in a 2x2 grid, each with a small geometric insignia, labelled Fjordborn, Ironclad, Hearthkin, Ashwalkers. Fjordborn is selected with a fine soft brass border. Below is one short doctrine panel: FJORD BORN / Hold the line. Support the front. Then a single full-width soft gold primary button DEPLOY TASK FORCE. Beneath it a quiet secondary text action Recovery key.
Style/medium: Crisp high-fidelity game interface mockup over beautifully composed low-poly 3D game art. Large condensed uppercase typography similar to Barlow Condensed, smaller highly legible narrow sans serif body copy. Flat matte deep pine panel surfaces, fine warm borders, quiet ivory type and restrained brass accents; calm spacing and no clutter.
Color palette: Muted teal-green, deep pine, ivory snow, substantial dark red timber buildings, dark slate roofs, restrained brass, warm winter light.
Text (verbatim): "NOORDHEIM", "NORTHERN COMMAND", "Callsign", "RAVEN-07", "Fjordborn", "Ironclad", "Hearthkin", "Ashwalkers", "FJORD BORN", "Hold the line. Support the front.", "DEPLOY TASK FORCE", "Recovery key".
Constraints: Clear practical interface, attractive close-up command post diorama, readable labels. This is a game home screen, not a website. No browser chrome, no photographs, no gradients on panel surfaces.
Avoid: No fantasy, no swords, no medieval huts, no neon, no rivets, no grunge, no metal slabs, no ornate borders, no glossy sci-fi panels, no excessive texture, no watermark.

hud.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 landscape actual gameplay HUD concept image for an existing Nordic 3D cooperative real-time strategy game, NOORDHEIM.
Primary request: Show an attractive, readable RTS gameplay screen where most of the image is a low-poly Nordic battlefield and the compact interface stays along the edges, providing ample visible 3D world.
Scene/backdrop: Sculpted low-poly spruce forests, chunky granite, patchy ivory snow and paths; a functional military base made of substantial red timber Nordic buildings with dark slate roofs; modern tracked harvesters and armoured vehicles, a few selected units with very subtle pale green selection rings. Elevated three-quarter RTS camera, warm low winter sunlight and pleasing long shadows, clear silhouettes and natural scale. Visible strategic paths and open clearing among the trees. Beautiful modern stylized game art, no fantasy.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:9 screen. The battlefield fills the screen, with overlays that are compact and genuinely game-native. A slim top resource bar reads NOORDHEIM at left, Credits 2,450, Power 80/150, Tier 1, and an Operations button at right. Upper-left under the bar: a compact objectives card with DEFEND THE COMMAND POST and Establish a forward base.
Right HUD: A narrow approximately 250px-wide production panel on a 1600px-wide frame at the right edge, leaving most screen area visible. Header PRODUCTION with tiny tabs UNITS and BUILDINGS. A 3-column grid of small square portrait cards depicts grounded low-poly tracked harvester, scout vehicle, armoured vehicle, command post, power station, and barracks. Each has an understated price label. A crisp square minimap sits below, showing the snowy dark-green landscape, a few tiny blue and amber unit dots, and a small viewport rectangle.
Bottom HUD: At bottom-left, one compact selected-unit card with a small tracked vehicle portrait, text HARVESTER and HP 180 / 180, plus a thin health bar. Bottom-middle has a small row of four command buttons with simple line icons, clearly labelled Move, Attack, Guard, Stop. Keep interface restrained in height with lots of open world between these panels.
Style/medium: Crisp high-fidelity actual game HUD mockup, quiet clean typography similar to Barlow Condensed, narrow legible sans-serif. Matched flat matte deep pine panels, ivory text, soft brass for active states, very light warm borders and calm clear spacing. Subtle translucent shadows around panel edges, no heavy framing.
Color palette: Muted teal-green and deep pine, ivory snow, red timber Nordic base, slate roofs, soft restrained brass.
Text (verbatim): "NOORDHEIM", "Credits 2,450", "Power 80/150", "Tier 1", "Operations", "DEFEND THE COMMAND POST", "Establish a forward base", "PRODUCTION", "UNITS", "BUILDINGS", "HARVESTER", "HP 180 / 180", "Move", "Attack", "Guard", "Stop".
Constraints: Actual playable-looking RTS battlefield and compact functional HUD. Keep the majority of screen visually open. Readable UI labels. UI proportions and spacing matter. World art matches sculpted low-poly Nordic military assets. No browser chrome.
Avoid: No fantasy, no swords, no medieval huts, no rivets, no grunge, no neon, no ornate fantasy borders, no metal slabs, no huge menus blocking the world, no glossy sci-fi ornament, no watermark.
